title: The Key to Shutting Down the Global Internet Lies Here
text:
The Key to Shutting Down the Global Internet Lies Here"

"🔹Al Jazeera reported that the internet cables that pass through the Persian Gulf, the Strait of Hormuz, and the Bab-el-Mandeb Strait provide 80% of the world's internet, and their disruption would lead to a complete global internet outage.
